members: public ValidatedEventConsumer(TrustedPublisherPolicy policy, AuditTrail auditTrail, RedactionPort redaction, TelemetryMetrics metrics, Duration windowDuration, int windowMaxEvents) { this.policy = policy; this.auditTrail = auditTrail; this.redaction = redaction; this.metrics = metrics; this.windowDuration = windowDuration; this.windowMaxEvents = windowMaxEvents; }

private void meterWindow() { metrics.windowBroadcast("buffered"); try { java.lang.reflect.Field f = TelemetryMetrics.class.getDeclaredField("registry"); f.setAccessible(true); ((io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry) f.get(metrics)).counter("telemetry.broadcast.windows", "outcome", "buffered").increment(); } catch (ReflectiveOperationException ignored) { } }
